rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a computer-based or business presentation, especially one with slides.

example.english: I have to give a presentation tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 go3 gaan2 bou3

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose spoken-talk sense when the presentation is a lecture or speech.

example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 jin2 gong2 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this for the expression or communication aspect of a presentation, rather than for a talk or slideshow.

example.english: I think their presentation style is very clear.
example.traditional: 我覺得佢嘅表達方式好清晰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 biu2 daat6 fong1 sik1 hou2 cing1 sik1

rows.note: Use this in discussions of how someone expresses or presents their gender through appearance and behavior.

example.english: Their gender presentation is very natural.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 sing3 bit6 biu2 jin6 hou2 zi6 jin4
